outputs.explanation: Panel A includes three bar graphs (Nuclear, Cytosolic, Mitochondrial fraction quantification) showing mean ± SD (N=4 stated), but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs only, with no plotted averages requiring individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot showing bands across lanes with no accompanying quantification plot.
Panel D is a western blot showing protein bands under different treatment conditions with no quantification plot of averaged data.
